features:
Key Features:

Made with Whole Grain Oats: Each serving provides a good amount of whole grains for steady energy.

Includes Real Dark Chocolate Chunks: Adds rich flavor and texture to balance the oats.

No Artificial Flavors or Colors: Made with simple, recognizable ingredients.

Crunchy Texture: Baked to deliver a satisfying crunch in every bite.

Double-Bar Packaging: Each pouch contains two bars, individually wrapped for convenience.

Benefits:

On-the-Go Convenience: Perfect for quick snacks, school lunches, work breaks, or travel.

Energy Boosting: Offers around 190 calories per pack—ideal for mid-morning or afternoon fuel.

Satisfies Sweet Cravings: Dark chocolate flavor gives it a slightly indulgent edge without being overwhelming.

Some Fiber and Protein: Contains around 3 grams of fiber and 4 grams of protein per serving to help with satiety.

Portable and Shelf-Stable: Great to keep in bags, desks, or cars for anytime snacking.
ingredients: Roasted Peanuts, Corn Syrup, Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Rice Flour, Palm Kernel Oil, Vegetable Glycerin, Peanut Butter (peanuts, salt), Fructose, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Whey, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Peanut Flour, Corn Starch, Barley Malt Extract, Honey Roasted Almond Butter (almonds, honey, maltodextrin, palm oil, mixed tocopherols), Baking Soda, Natural Flavor, Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
